question: If ΔABC and ΔPQR are similar. AB = 8 cm, PQ = 12 cm, QR = 18 cm and RP = 24 cm, then the perimeter of ΔABC is _________ cm.
solution:
**Given :-**

ΔABC and ΔPQR are similar

AB = 8 cm

PQ = 12 cm

QR = 18 cm 

RP = 24 cm

**Concept Use :-**

Two triangles are similar if they have the same ratio of corresponding sides and equal pair of corresponding angles. 

 [IMAGE: https://lms.testbook.com/kcfinder/browse.php?type=images&CKEditor=editor10&CKEditorFuncNum=910&langCode=en] [IMAGE: https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcRY59ww3aLCVc9UwtX-5V4kNwwqX4vUUD4dIGW-W-YocCH5v9_PNf0B5YmrSjNDPqjP_gQ&usqp=CAU] 

(1) AB/PQ = BC/QR = AC/PR

(2) angle A = angle P , angle B = angle Q , angle C = angle R

**Calculation :-**

⇒ AB/PQ = BC/QR = AC/PR

⇒ 8/12 = BC/18 = AC/24

⇒ BC = (18 × 8) /12 = 12cm

and,

⇒ AC = (12 × 24) /18 = 16 cm

Now,

⇒ Perimeter of triangle ABC = AB +BC + AC = 8 + 12 + 16

⇒ Perimeter of triangle ABC = **36cm**
